Mer.reason: Mer refers to the Match Error Rate (MER) metric, not a language.

Moo.reason: Moo is a model abbreviation (Moonshine-AR) used in tables, not a language.

egyptian arabic.reason: Egyptian Arabic is a dialect included in the benchmark and evaluated across ASR systems.

Arabic.reason: Arabic is the target language of the benchmark, with ASR systems evaluated on it.

English.reason: English is only used as the language for providing elicitation instructions, not studied in ASR evaluation.
